notes.title: New Updates - Reduced Difficulty
notes.notes:
Hello players,

I have noticed that many players were having issues progressing in my game due to the difficulty level. I have updated the following to make progression a lot less stressful. Please see below for new updates.

[b][u]Patch 1.0[/u][/b]

1. Reduced all enemy health to allow easier kills.

2. Increased player's health from 100 to 150 points. This will allow players to leak a little bit more monsters.

3. Level 1 difficulty had been significantly reduced. This will allow players to get the hang of the battle system before advancing to level 2. And for successful grinding if players have issues advancing levels.

So far these are implemented, I will further review and provide updates for better playing experience.

Thank you everyone for your patience and support with my game ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Game Guides Are Posted
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Want to let all of you know that I have posted Game Guides to provide players with basic knowledge of...

- Casting non-charged and charged spells
- Spell upgrades and resets
- Elemental damaging system
- Battles guides: hints and tips

These can be accessed in the Community section under Guides.

Once again, thank you for your support in playing my game. Let me know if you run into issues and I will try my best to answer your questions.
